prompt: Create ONE native editable SVG contact sheet for Scrapyard, a compact top-down salvage-yard survival game. Static vector paths and simple shapes only. No raster images, fonts, visible text, scripts, animation, filters, gradients, external resources, use references or defs. Each cell must be a named top-level group using LOCAL coordinates with a single grid translate. No background rectangles for sprites; genuinely transparent outside silhouettes. No borders, labels, cast shadows or debris outside the named subject. Each sprite centered on its exact cell center, safe margins, with all its paths INSIDE its group. Economical geometry, fewer than 14 filled shapes per subject. Do not use strokes thinner than 5 units. Broad worn steel and cloth planes, strong asymmetrical silhouettes, three value groups, upper-left light. Dark forest ink #142622; shadow #30483e; steel #a5b4a2; cream #e9dbb7; restrained copper #b97c5e. Favor readable 20px contours over detailed engraving. No photorealism, plastic gloss, ornament or tiny clutter. All subjects are finished coherent siblings. THREE columns, TWO rows, 320x320 cells, no gutters. Canvas/viewBox 960x640. Empty last cell. Row-major groups: survivor translate(0 0), drifter translate(320 0), runner translate(640 0), brute translate(0 320), spitter translate(320 320). Sprite bounding area x=40..280 y=40..280, centered at 160,160. These are game sprites viewed from high oblique above, facing toward screen bottom, with connected broad shoulders/hoods and short feet, not portraits or circular badges. Survivor: compact yellow #f4cf74 coated scavenger, tilted hood, dark open visor, asymmetrical shoulder and two small planted boots; narrower than tall, warm yellow dominant. Drifter: slumped broad scrap hood and ragged poncho, warm rust #e6a674 dominant, sagging shoulder, two dark sockets. Runner: narrow coral #da7c70 forward wedge, swept hood and one thrusting shoulder, clearly narrower/angular than Drifter, sparse body detail. Brute: low wide plated shoulders, plum #ad93c6 broad dominant plane, small recessed head, heavy unequal shoulder plates and two squat feet; notably wider silhouette. Spitter: teal #8acbbd pressure vessel body, flattened shoulders and prominent dark forward socket at bottom center. NO fixed aimed barrel or warning ring: those remain separate game overlays. Keep faces secondary and silhouettes distinct at survivor26x32 / Drifter20 / Runner20 / Brute30 / Spitter24 logical pixels. Sprite density matters: no narrow isolated limbs or hairlines.
